segment_captions.caption: C holds a red vacuum cleaner upright on the floor, preparing to use it.

C holds a red vacuum cleaner, moving it along the floor. The vacuum cleaner's hose is extended, and C appears to be inspecting or adjusting it. The background shows a kitchen area with wooden cabinets and a bar stool.
C picks up a white plastic part from a red vacuum cleaner and examines it closely.
C looks around the room, focusing on a vacuum cleaner with a coiled hose and a white attachment. The camera briefly shifts focus, blurring the view momentarily.
